channel.title: NorthStar Prime Open-Science Preprints, Dissertations & Monographs
channel.description: Peer-review preprints, doctoral dissertations, scientific field bibles, and open-hardware engineering monographs from NorthStar Prime.

item.title: A 45-Species Taxonomic, Phytochemical, and Forensic Lookalike Toxicology Compendium: The Master Herbal Bible (Pass 428)
item.description: This monograph presents a 45-species botanical, morphological, phytochemical, and clinical-safety compendium verified against Royal Botanic Gardens Kew Plants of the World Online (POWO), the USDA PLANTS Database, Linnaeus (1753), and European Medicines Agency (EMA) HMPC monographs. We map primary carbon and nitrogen transmutation into three secondary metabolic super-pathways (mevalonate/MEP terpenoids, shikimate phenylpropanoids, and alk(en)yl cysteine sulfoxides), establish field-diagnostic separation matrices for high-consequence toxic lookalikes (Symphytum officinale vs. Digitalis purpurea; Daucus carota vs. Conium maculatum and Cicuta douglasii; Arctium lappa vs. Atropa belladonna), and codify strict pharmacological guardrails for calcineurin-inhibitor transplant regimens (Hypericum perforatum and Schisandra chinensis CYP3A4/P-gp modulation) and chronic kidney disease (Glycyrrhiza glabra 11-beta-HSD2 inhibition and Curcuma longa soluble oxalate load).

item.title: Cascadia Bioregional Mycoflora, Caffeic-Acid Bioluminescence, Amatoxin Epidemiology, and the Thermodynamics of Cellular Chitin Searing
item.description: Synthesizing 45 mycological chapters and commercial agricultural research from Yamhill County, Oregon (Oregon Tilth Certified Organic OT-011161; ORS 616.706-.726), this monograph examines four interconnected domains of fungal biology and gastronomy: (1) the four-enzyme genetically encodable caffeic acid bioluminescence cycle (HispS, H3H, Luz, CPH; lambda_max ~ 520-530 nm); (2) four elevation-stratified fruiting corridors across the Pacific Northwest Cascadia bioregion; (3) forensic lookalike toxicology incorporating the November 2025 - March 2026 Northern California amatoxin outbreak (CDC MMWR 75(20):258-263, 2026; doi:10.15585/mmwr.mm7520a2); and (4) the two-stage dry-evaporation and Maillard searing protocol for cross-linked chitin/beta-glucan cell walls at 425°F (218°C), a hypothesized, not yet measured, retention model for the sulfur-histidine antioxidant L-ergothioneine.

item.title: Helios, Hydros, Aer, and Terra: A Unified Doctoral Dissertation Synthesizing Solar Photochemistry, Mycelial Biogeochemistry, Botanical Phytochemistry, Culinary Thermodynamics, Global Flavor Systems, and Precision Clinical Renal Nutrition
item.description: This doctoral dissertation synthesizes nine research programs and over 1,300 documented formulations, botanical/mycological monographs, and clinical trials to trace how four elemental reservoirs—Sun (photons), Water (H2O), Air (CO2, N2, O2), and Earth (lithospheric mineral ions)—transmute into global human nourishment. Structured across six books, it unites (I) chloroplast photochemistry, nitrogenase fixation, and mycorrhizal mineral weathering; (II) 45 Kew POWO-verified botanical monographs; (III) 45 mycological chapters and chitin searing thermodynamics; (IV) 126 molecular gastronomy studies, a 91-source crust-crisping physics analysis (4:1:1 potato:corn:tapioca ternary starch optimization), receptor neurogastronomy, and commercial three-pass 500°F deck oven rheology; (V) 153 global flavor formulations across four continents and 8 cross-modal plant-based sensory illusions; and (VI) KDOQI 2020 / KDIGO 2024 hemodialysis nutrition adequacy and planetary abundance engineering.

item.title: Formal Physical, Information-Theoretic, and Computability Constraints on the Simulation Hypothesis: A Critical Scholarly Monograph
item.description: This monograph provides a critical, quantitative synthesis of the peer-reviewed literature across theoretical physics, quantum complexity theory, lattice gauge theory, astrophysical polarimetry, statistical mechanics, and formal computability theory concerning the Simulation Hypothesis. Companion deterministic Python verification code (simulation_bounds_verifier.py, 10/10 pytest checks passing) reproduces: (1) Kipping's (2020) Bayesian Model Averaging posterior P(Base | D0) ~ 0.5022 vs. P(Sim | D0) ~ 0.4978; (2) Ringel & Kovrizhin's (2017) topological no-go theorem proving an intrinsic Quantum Monte Carlo sign problem for (2+1)D chiral gravitational anomalies on classical BPP architectures; (3) Symanzik effective field theory GZK cosmic-ray lattice bounds (b <= 1.97e-27 m; Beane et al. 2014) and INTEGRAL GRB 041219A vacuum birefringence bounds (l_grain < 1e-48 m; Laurent et al. 2011); (4) Vazza's (2025) irreversible Landauer power bound (P_min ~ 3.39e44 W) contrasted against Bennett's (1973) reversible unitary gates and Edge & Brown's (2026) observer-bounded evaluation (~8e25 ops/s, reducing throughput by 1.625e41x); and (5) Wolpert's (2024-2025) formal recursion-theoretic proof via Kleene's Second Recursion Theorem and Rice's Theorem that an error-free simulation is algorithmically undecidable from within.

item.title: Multimodal Receptor Architecture for Dietary Sodium Reduction Without Potassium Chloride: Crystal Hydrodynamics, Proton-Heat Cross-Modality, Kokumi CaSR Allostery, and Retronasal Aroma Compensation
item.description: Patients with advanced chronic kidney disease (CKD Stages 3-5 and maintenance dialysis) are advised to restrict dietary sodium (<2.0 g/day per KDIGO 2024), yet commercial potassium chloride (KCl) salt substitutes pose severe hyperkalemia risks (Greer et al., Hypertension, 2020) and activate bitter receptors TAS2R (Sinopoli & Lawless, 2012). This paper synthesizes primary sensory and physiological literature across four non-KCl sodium-reduction mechanisms: (1) salt crystal morphology and spatial contrast, distinguishing volumetric spoon-density differences (47%-53% lower Na mass per tablespoon for hollow flake/hopper pyramids vs. cubic table salt; USDA FDC 173468) from gram-for-gram human sensory reductions (20%-25% via dissolution kinetics, Rama et al., 2013; 28% via surface spatial distribution, Noort et al., 2010); (2) organic acid proton (OTOP1; Tu et al., 2018) and trigeminal capsaicin/piperine (TRPV1; Tominaga et al., 1998) cross-modal central salt enhancement (~2.5 g/day salt reduction in human trials; Li et al., Hypertension, 2017); (3) allosteric activation of the calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR) by gamma-glutamyl peptides in slow-roasted alliums (Ohsu et al., JBC, 2010); and (4) retronasal odor-induced saltiness enhancement (OISE, compensating 20%-30% NaCl reduction; Lawrence et al., 2009).

item.title: NorthStar Invention Forge MK1–MK55: Parametric CAD, KiCad Schematic Architecture, and Theoretical Applied Physics Derivations
item.description: This compendium packages the theoretical engineering derivations, ISO-10303-21 STEP solid-model geometries, KiCad 8.0 schematic netlists, and bills of materials across the NorthStar Invention Forge series (MK1 through MK55), accompanied by our automated structural verifier (engineering_integrity.py). In strict compliance with NorthStar's engineering integrity standard, all designs are published with explicit epistemic provenance distinguishing verified physical governing equations and structural file completeness from physical prototype fabrication certification.

item.title: Precision Clinical Renal Nutrition & Medication Safety in Maintenance Hemodialysis: A Scoping Synthesis of KDOQI 2020, KDIGO 2024, Phosphorus Bioavailability, and Transplant CYP3A4 Guardrails
item.description: Synthesizing 53 clinical trials and nephrology practice guidelines (KDOQI 2020, ADA 2026 Section 11, KDIGO 2024, CONVINCE, PIVOTAL), this scoping review formalizes six computational and clinical guardrails for maintenance hemodialysis (CKD Stage 5D) nutrition informatics: (1) preserving 1.0-1.2 g/kg/day high-biological-value protein to prevent protein-energy wasting (PEW); (2) stratifying dietary phosphorus by gastrointestinal bioavailability (20%-40% plant phytate < 40%-60% animal organic < 90%-100% inorganic 'phos' additives; Kalantar-Zadeh et al., CJASN, 2010); (3) enforcing a strict 'Missing != Zero' database integrity rule for undeclared phosphorus in USDA Branded Foods; (4) accounting for culinary potassium-leaching heterogeneity (Martinez-Pineda et al., 2020; Batista et al., 2021) and prohibiting KCl salt substitutes; (5) USDA safe minimum internal cooking temperatures (145°F fish / 165°F poultry); and (6) excluding cannabinoids (THC/CBD) from renal culinary programs because their pharmacokinetics in advanced CKD are poorly studied, they are not expected to be meaningfully removed by dialysis (high protein binding), and cannabidiol (CBD) increased tacrolimus exposure 3.1-fold (AUC) and 4.2-fold (Cmax) in a Phase I trial (Clin Pharmacol Ther 2025; PMID 39601108; doi:10.1002/cpt.3504).

item.title: Comparative Anthropological History of World Religions, Trans-Ethnic Mystical Invariants, and Predictive Game-Theoretic Historiography
item.description: This five-part humanities working-paper series examines the evolutionary anthropology of human ritual and religious systems from Upper Paleolithic shamanic complexes and Neolithic agricultural pantheons through the Axial Age transformations (Vedic/Upanishadic, Buddhist, Daoist, Confucian, Zoroastrian, Abrahamic, and Indigenous traditions), paired with formal game-theoretic modeling of institutional cooperation, elite overproduction, and strategic equilibrium transitions in historical civilizations.

item.title: The Definitive Book of Hyperbaric Chamber Therapy: A 24-Chapter Quantitative Biophysical, Molecular, ASME PVHO-1 / NFPA 99 Engineering, and Evidence-Stratified Clinical Monograph
item.description: Complete 24-chapter, 80-page reference monograph, EPUB 3.0 e-book, 6-page clinical console wall-charts atlas, and 50-question ABMS Undersea & Hyperbaric Medicine board-review workbook synthesizing gas physics (Dalton, Henry, Boyle, Fick, Krogh cylinder), the Hyperoxic-Hypoxic Paradox (HIF-1alpha, SIRT1, PGC-1alpha, 8-fold CD34+ stem cell mobilization), ASME PVHO-1 / NFPA 99 Chapter 14 engineering, all 15 UHMS 15th Edition indications, 43 Europe PMC peer-reviewed papers (off-label uses graded as early evidence), and 26 ClinicalTrials.gov trials.

item.title: The Definitive Guide to Clinical Photobiomodulation, Multi-Spectral Light Therapy & The 5-Pillar Pentad Therapeutic Architecture
item.description: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD Stages 3-5) and End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) present an interlocking pentad of vascular access failure, mitochondrial Complex IV nitric-oxide inhibition, intractable uremic pruritus, sodium-driven volume overload, and polypharmacy toxicity. This monograph and deterministic software suite unify multi-spectral photobiomodulation (311-12,000 nm), hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT), receptor neurogastronomy (zero-KCl), and endocannabinoid systems pharmacology, backed by 102 open-access Europe PMC articles, 39 ClinicalTrials.gov studies, and 137 passing pytest checks.
